# Rule changes by nation and season, 0.6.0 (draft)

Every change between consecutive seasons in docs/research/rules-0.6.0, from 2001/02 to 2025/26. Calendar-year leagues show the real year after the season. A value of unknown is skipped.
5032 changes in total.

## What the game will not do

A row of the rules files states the real rule. The game limits some of them, so the report lists the real change and marks the limit. Two limits apply in 0.6.0:

- The bench and the substitutes used stay at 9 or fewer (Q375). The match engine clamps at 9. A real rule of more than 9 shows in the report, and the game plays 9.
- The MLS stays at 12 clubs (Q404). The group code of the original holds 12. MLS expansion clubs get no place.

Source: docs/specs/2026-10-16-seasons-0.6.0-spec.md.

- 2023/24: transfer windows changes from "two registration periods: one between seasons (max 12 weeks) and one mid-season (max 4 weeks); exact dates: unknown" to "two registration periods (FIFA RSTP March 2023 edition, in force 1 April 2023): first 8 to 12 weeks between seasons, second 4 to 8 weeks mid-season, at most 16 weeks together; HNS dates: unknown".
